Luxury Presence is a website builder and marketing platform for real estate agents. They build high-end websites with IDX integration, CRM tools, and offer social media management as a premium add-on. Starting at approximately $500/month with setup fees of $4,000 to $5,000, Luxury Presence locks you into annual contracts with no early cancellation. Their social media service covers a limited number of platforms and does not include custom local content or video editing.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The Verdict: Luxury Presence vs VEXI

A premium website builder with high-end design and IDX integration. Social media management is available as an add-on but limited to a few platforms with no video editing or custom local content/graphics. Annual contracts required. Setup fees start at $4,000+. Support response times are a common complaint.
Is Luxury Presence a done-for-you social media service?
Not in the same way. Luxury Presence is primarily a website builder and marketing platform. They offer social media management as a premium add-on, but their focus is websites, IDX, and CRM tools.
Does Luxury Presence require a contract?

Yes. Luxury Presence typically requires annual contracts, especially for bundled service plans. You are locked in for a minimum of one year with no early cancellation option. VEXI has no contracts — cancel anytime, no questions asked.
Does Luxury Presence include video editing?
No. Luxury Presence does not include short-form video editing as part of their social media management.
Can I keep my website if I cancel Luxury Presence?

Multiple customers have reported being told they would lose their website if they canceled their Luxury Presence subscription. Your website is hosted on their proprietary platform and is not portable. VEXI focuses on social media content — your social media accounts and all content posted to them are always yours.
